jobs.description: Our team is engineering a next-generation platform infrastructure to enable agentic, closed-loop network automation and orchestration for service providers and large enterprise networks. jobs.title: Custom Software Engineer
jobs.description: Project Role : Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : Embedded Product Verification & Validation Good to have skills: NA Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification: Bachelors degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering Computer or Electrical Engineering Automotive Engineering or equivalent technical experience is required Summary: The Test Lead will lead day-to-day planning, execution and maintenance of synthetic test scenarios for complex vehicle software and simulation systems. The role translates high-level behavioral requirements, hypothetical test intents and diagrams into clear, parameterized test scenarios. The Test Lead will provide hands-on technical guidance to a multidisciplinary team, review scenario quality and coverage, support issue resolution and coordinate delivery across US and India teams. The focus is on delivering diverse, robust scenarios that test the intended behavior while respecting physical and logical constraints. Roles & Responsibilities: Lead day-to-day test planning, scenario generation, execution and maintenance in line with the agreed test strategy and delivery plan. Translate high-level test intents, diagrams and behavioral requirements into clear scenario specifications, parameters and acceptance criteria. Design and review diverse scenario permutations using combinatorial testing, with clear coverage goals and minimal unnecessary duplication. Review interactions between software modules, state machines, environmental physics and simulator configurations to ensure scenarios test the intended system behavior. Develop and maintain reusable configuration rules and parameter sets for reliable bulk generation and execution across automated data pipelines. Apply scenario quality checks, boundary conditions, tolerances and metrics to distinguish genuine behavioral issues from acceptable execution variation. Lead scenario reviews and test execution investigate issues and coordinate defect reporting, retesting and closure with software and simulation engineering teams. Coordinate scenario updates as requirements, simulator configurations and testing methodologies evolve. Estimate testing effort, allocate daily work and coordinate dependencies and handovers across US and India delivery teams escalate capacity gaps and delivery blockers. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to team members working across simulation engineering, technical art, level design and procedural generation. Track test execution progress, scenario coverage, defects, maintenance needs and technical risks, and report status and priorities to stakeholders. Support evolving methods, including synthetic transformation of logged events and procedural agent injection into real-world telemetry. Professional & Technical Skills: Test planning and coordination: Ability to estimate testing effort, prioritize scenarios, assign tasks and track execution and maintenance against the delivery plan. Hands-on technical leadership: Ability to review team outputs, resolve technical questions, mentor team members and maintain consistent testing practices. Analytical thinking: Strong problem-solving skills to break down complex requirements, identify dependencies and make evidence-based decisions. Stakeholder communication: Ability to explain test coverage, defects, technical constraints, risks and delivery status clearly to engineering and business stakeholders. Global collaboration: Ability to coordinate daily work across distributed teams, manage cross-location dependencies and maintain clear handovers. Quality focus: A structured approach to scenario reviews, documentation, traceability and reproducible issue reporting. Adaptability: Ability to work with different specialist skills and adjust testing approaches as methods and tools evolve Systems architecture and modular thinking: Strong understanding of interdependent software architectures, state machines and the interactions between software modules, environmental physics and simulator configurations. Parametric design and spatial logic: Ability to apply Boolean logic, geometric constraints and time-based conditions to dynamic 3D environments. Synthetic scenario design: Ability to translate abstract test intents and diagrams into realistic, varied scenarios that challenge behavioral requirements without violating physical or logical constraints. Combinatorial testing: Ability to design parameter combinations that provide broad, meaningful coverage without unnecessary overlap. Algorithmic scalability: Ability to define reusable, programmatic rulesets and configurations that remain reliable across variable inputs and high-volume automated pipelines. Robustness and boundary value analysis: Strong understanding of edge cases, tolerances and metrics that isolate the intended signal while allowing acceptable execution variation. Simulation configuration: Ability to review and troubleshoot scenario configurations, system states and simulator behavior. Tools and configuration languages: Experience with visual node-based tools such as Unreal Engine Blueprints or Unity, or configuration languages such as JSON and XML, is beneficial. Scenario lifecycle management: Ability to maintain reusable scenario libraries and assess the impact of changes to requirements, configurations and simulation environments. Evolving testing methods: Understanding of synthetic transformation of logged events and procedural agent injection into real-world telemetry is beneficial Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 9 years of experience in Embedded Product Verification & Validation with 5 years of experience in Synthetic test Generation. - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. - A Bachelors degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering Computer or Electrical Engineering Automotive Engineering (Systems and Controls), Applied Mathematics, Physics, or equivalent technical experience is required. Qualification Bachelors degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering Computer or Electrical Engineering Automotive Engineering or equivalent technical experience is required 9-14 Yrs Embedded systems, Architecture, Maintenance, Mathematics, Application, Node, Reporting, Electrical engineering

The role requires strong diagnostic reasoning, an understanding of complex software architectures and state machines, and the ability to translate observed system behavior into precise, bounded simulation parameters. The Senior Analyst will develop reusable configurations and programmatic rulesets that work reliably across varied automated data pipelines, rather than relying on single-instance scenario creation. Roles & Responsibilities: Perform log-based test generation and maintenance, with a focus on diagnostic accuracy and reproducible simulation scenarios. Analyze system logs and real-world telemetry to identify relevant events, infer system states, isolate variables and investigate the causes of observed behavior. Define strict inclusion criteria for selecting log events and translate them into bounded simulation parameters. Understand how software modules, state machines, environmental physics and simulator configurations interact to produce the behavior under test. Define scenario logic using Boolean conditions, geometric constraints and time-based predicates within dynamic 3D environments. Develop reusable configurations, test parameters and programmatic rulesets that can be applied in bulk across highly variable automated data pipelines. Design boundary-value and edge-case tests, with clear metrics and tolerances that isolate the intended signal while allowing acceptable minor execution variances. Maintain scenarios and configurations as system behavior, source logs and simulation inputs change, checking that the intended test conditions remain valid. Review scenario definitions and diagnostic findings for clarity, consistency and traceability to the source telemetry. Professional & Technical Skills: Strong deductive reasoning and analytical judgment to reverse-engineer observed behavior and troubleshoot complex issues. Systems-level thinking, with the ability to move from individual scenarios to reusable rules that support large-scale automated execution. A structured and detail-oriented approach to defining inclusion criteria, documenting assumptions and checking diagnostic conclusions. Clear technical communication and the ability to explain scenario logic, system interactions and findings to a distributed team. Systems Architecture & Modular Thinking: Understand complex, interdependent software architectures and state machines, including the interaction of discrete modules, environmental physics and simulator configurations. Log Analysis & Diagnostic Troubleshooting: Parse system logs, interpret telemetry, isolate variables and translate real-world events into accurate, bounded simulation parameters. Parametric Design & Spatial Logic: Apply Boolean logic, geometric constraints and time-based predicates to dynamic 3D environments. Algorithmic Scalability: Design configurations and test parameters that remain reliable across variable automated data pipelines, using programmatic rulesets that can be applied in bulk. Robustness & Boundary Value Analysis: Identify edge cases, define suitable tolerances and design metrics that distinguish the intended signal from acceptable minor execution variances. Configuration & Visual Logic Tools: Experience with visual node-based logic, such as Unreal Engine Blueprints or Unity, or complex configuration languages such as JSON and XML is beneficial. Relevant Backgrounds: Experience in QA automation engineering, data analysis, Tier 3 technical support or systems integration may provide a suitable foundation when supported by the core competencies above. In this role, you will work closely with senior developers, AI engineers, and security specialists to build, test, and secure modern web applications and autonomous Agentic AI workflows. This is a hands-on opportunity to ship production-ready code, integrate intelligent AI agents into customer-facing products, and implement security-first engineering practices. Key Responsibilities Full-Stack Development: Assist in designing, coding, and maintaining scalable frontend and backend features for web applications. Agentic AI Integration: Help build, orchestrate, and deploy autonomous Agentic AI models capable of multi-step reasoning, tool calling, memory management, and API interactions. Security-First Engineering: Implement secure coding practices, input sanitization, authentication/authorization flows, and guardrails against AI specific vulnerabilities (such as prompt injection and data leakage). Build Interfaces: Translate UI/UX designs into clean, responsive, and interactive frontend components (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Next.js) tailored for real-time AI streaming and agent feedback. Implement APIs & Databases: Write, test, and integrate RESTful or GraphQL APIs, manage relational or NoSQL data models, and work with vector databases for AI context retrieval. Agentic AI & LLM Foundations: Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, function/tool calling, and agentic orchestration frameworks (such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or AutoGen). Application & AI Security Basics: Understanding of web security fundamentals (OWASP Top 10), secure authentication (OAuth 2.0, JWT), API rate limiting, and awareness of LLM security risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, prompt injection mitigation, and PII protection). Databases & Storage: Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), and basic exposure to vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Chroma, or Weaviate). Version Control: Comfortable using Git and GitHub for branching, committing, and pull requests. Nice-to-Have Skills Hands-on experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines or multi-agent workflows. Knowledge of sandboxing/containerization tools (Docker) for safely executing AI-generated code or agent tools. Familiarity with AI evaluation frameworks, observability tools (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix), or cloud security practices (AWS/GCP IAM). Personal AI/security projects, hackathon experience, or open-source contributions on GitHub. 3-7 Yrs Full Stack, Cloud, Fullstack Development, Application development, Ai Platform, Mobile application development, React.js, DBMS

LLM Ecosystem Expertise: Experience with tools and libraries such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, and OpenAI/Anthropic APIs.
